# APIShield // OWASP API Security Top 10 Automated Pentesting Engine

> Official AI & LLM Context Manifest for https://apishield-pi.vercel.app/

## Project Information
- **Name**: APIShield
- **Author**: Arfa Danial (@nyzxis)
- **Author Portfolio**: https://nyzxis.vercel.app/
- **Live Application**: https://apishield-pi.vercel.app/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/nyzxis/apishield

## Overview
APIShield is an automated REST API security testing and offensive pentesting suite targeting the OWASP API Security Top 10 (2023). It executes non-destructive security audits against RESTful microservices, diagnosing BOLA/IDOR object tampering, broken JWT authentication, parameter mass assignment, and CORS leaks with reproducible cURL exploits and enterprise remediation snippets.

## Technical Specifications
- **Backend Engine**: Python 3.11, FastAPI, Requests, PostgreSQL / SQLite Fallback
- **Frontend UI**: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Lucide React
- **OWASP Vectors Tested**: API1 (BOLA), API2 (Broken Auth & alg=none JWT), API3 (Mass Assignment), API4 (Rate Limiting), API5 (BFLA), API7 (CORS Misconfigurations), API9 (Shadow Inventory), API10 (Input Fuzzing).
